component.name: Go for It Qt
component.summary: To-do list with built-in productivity timer, SQLite storage, TUI, and multi-tracker sync

description.p: Go for It Qt is a modern C++20 / Qt 6 productivity application combining task management with a Pomodoro timer, terminal TUI, and multi-tracker integrations.

ul.li: Single-file SQLite storage with backup export/import and customizable path
Native integrations: GitHub, GitLab, Jira, JetBrains YouTrack, Redmine, Todoist, and Nextcloud Tasks (CalDAV)
Unified multi-account and multi-list views with per-integration remote status and priority mapping
Console Terminal UI (go-for-it-tui) with full Vim keybindings and ANSI priority colors
Productivity Analytics Dashboard with Pomodoro charts, context distribution, heatmap, and PDF/CSV reports
Always-on-top Mini-Player (PiP) window for uninterrupted focus
Due dates (due:YYYY-MM-DD) and smart filters (Today, Overdue, This Week)
Procedural Ambient Focus Sound Generator (White Noise, Rain, Ticking Clock)
Quick browser jump (xdg-open) via 'w'/'gx' in TUI or link button in GUI
Automatic Pomodoro worklog / time logging to remote issue trackers

description.p: Maintenance release 2.0.1: resolves 87 stability defects across tracker synchronization (Jira, YouTrack, Nextcloud, GitHub, GitLab, Redmine, Todoist), Terminal UI formatting, schedule arithmetic normalization, and timer reliability.

Major 2.0.0 release: full C++20 and Qt 6 architecture, standalone Vim-style Terminal UI, 7 issue tracker integrations, productivity analytics dashboard, PiP mini-player, due dates, ambient focus sound, and priority mapping.
